Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CAST(COALESCE(losses.Total_Loss, 0) AS decimal(18,2)) /
        NULLIF(COALESCE(premiums.Total_Premium, 0), 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
) losses
    ON losses.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) premiums
    ON premiums.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.party_name AS policy_holder,
    ag.party_name AS agent,
    COALESCE(prm.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        MIN(CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'INSURED', 'HOLDER')
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) phr
    ON phr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        MIN(CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('AGENT', 'PRODUCER', 'BROKER')
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) agr
    ON agr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50)) AS Party_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS party_name
    FROM Party
    GROUP BY CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))
) ph
    ON ph.Party_Identifier = phr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50)) AS Party_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS party_name
    FROM Party
    GROUP BY CAST(Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))
) ag
    ON ag.Party_Identifier = agr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?
What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number;
